signed_action.ledger: PROTECTED_HELD_OUT append-only nonce and approval ledger
signed_action.revocation: any role, identity, artifact, vulnerability, or policy revocation invalidates dependent approvals
signed_action.rotation: rotate workload credentials and signing material before expiration or immediately after compromise

trusted_input_contract.signature_verification: the protected promotion caller verifies every signed required field, including requested_sandbox_access and publication action intent, against the existing identity before invoking validate-policy
trusted_input_contract.role_snapshot: snapshot_roles is an authoritative artifact-scoped projection from repository permissions and protected environments, never candidate-authored data
trusted_input_contract.nonce_snapshot: prior_nonces is an authoritative read from the PROTECTED_HELD_OUT append-only ledger, never candidate-authored data
trusted_input_contract.artifact_digest_snapshot: expected_artifact_digest is an authoritative independently approved fresh-byte digest supplied by the protected caller, never candidate-authored data
trusted_input_contract.classification_snapshot: publication.classification is an authoritative classifier projection supplied by the protected caller, never candidate-authored data
trusted_input_contract.time_source: expiration is evaluated against the validator host UTC clock; the signed issued_at field is not a verifier clock substitute

sandbox.resources: bounded CPU, memory, processes, disk, and wall time

repository_enforcement.permissions: repository teams map existing identities to exactly one artifact-scoped role per snapshot
